scripts.test: node --test tests/deployment-config.test.mjs && node scripts/run-browser-integration.mjs preview && node scripts/run-browser-integration.mjs production --grep "preview fixture is available only in the preview environment"
scripts.preview:local: npm run build && npm run db:preview:local && wrangler pages dev dist --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/local-state --d1 DB=00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 --binding APP_ENV=preview
scripts.db:preview:local: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs preview && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --local --persist-to .wrangler/local-state && wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --local --persist-to .wrangler/local-state --file=./db/seed-preview.sql
scripts.db:preview: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs preview --require-real-id && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --remote && wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=./db/seed-preview.sql
scripts.db:production: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs production --require-real-id && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.deploy:preview: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs preview --require-real-id && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch preview
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs production --require-real-id && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch main
